instructions.question: Does this Facebook comment on the Kosovo public health institute's COVID-19 post express warm approval, respect or hope, an explicit hostile or distressed feeling, or neither (information, requests, suggestions, banter)?
instructions.rule: Neutral is the default. Data requests, 'why' questions, demands for measures, comparisons with other countries, scolding of mask-skippers, sarcasm about testing and city 'league' banter stay neutral, even when critical. Choose negative only for an explicit marker: blame, a claim that the numbers are fake, insults or curses, a fed-up statement, the commenter's own fear or despair, or bitter irony mocking Kosovo or the government. Positive needs praise, thanks, respectful courtesy ('Me respekt'), relief or hope for zero cases; praise mixed with criticism stays positive.

neutral.what: Tags, statistics, observations, requests for details, questions, proposals, mask reminders, comparisons, jokes and banter, including mildly critical or sarcastic ones.
examples: Mbyllni kufinjt mos luani me jetet e njerzve (Close the borders, don't play with people's lives)
Nëse nuk bëjmë asnjë test, s'do të kemi asnjë rast. U zgjidh problemi. (If we do no tests, we'll have no cases. Problem solved.)
Jeckpoot...vushtri e dhezi..apet (Jackpot... Vushtrri lit up again)
neutral.cues: personal names, publikoni (publish), testoni (test), mbyllni (close), pse (why), ma gjall (livelier), on top, hahaha
neutral.not_for: Explicit blame, fake-number claims, insults, being fed up, own fear, or bitter mockery are negative.

positive.what: Praise or thanks to doctors or the institute, respectful polite messages, congratulations, hope or prayers for no cases, cheering at recoveries.
examples: Respekt per punen tuaj (Respect for your work)
shpresoj qe ta kalojmë këtë gjendje me sa më pak pasoja. (I hope we get through this with as few consequences as possible.)
Ajde ma gjall ma gjall t sherum (Come on, more and more recovered)
positive.cues: bravo (well done), respekt/me respekt (respect/with respect), te nderuar (dear sirs), faleminderit (thanks), urime (congratulations), shpresoj (I hope), inshallah (God willing), asnje rast (no cases)
positive.not_for: City-ranking banter ('n Top form') and 'ma gjall' cheering of infections are neutral. Ironic praise of something bad ('e vetmja gjë pozitive') is negative.

negative.what: Blame, claims the numbers are invented, insults or curses, fed-up frustration, fear or despair, bitter irony at Kosovo or the government, gloating that a city lost control.
examples: Qeveria koti ika fajet (The Kurti government is to blame)
Veq shifren e par pja ndrroni se tekstin tjeter veq copy paste po get (You only change the first number, the rest is copy paste)
"Si gjithcka tjeter  edhe COVID 19 do te deshtoj ne Kosove" (Like everything else, COVID 19 will fail in Kosovo too)
Krejt Rrena (All lies)
negative.cues: faj (blame), rrena (lies), aparati (the machine), bajat (stale), lodhet (tired), spo na intereson (we don't care), magari (donkey), pisa (dirty one), flaka ju dalt (may you burn), ju raft (may it strike you), Koti/Kotit (mocking Kurti), e hupi kontrollen (lost control), tmerr (horror)
negative.not_for: Requests, proposals, questions or banter without such a marker are neutral.
